lesson.title: Be a corner detective
lesson.subtitle: Recognise a right angle
lesson.story: A right angle has the same opening as a square corner. Compare each card with the reference corner.
lesson.objective: Identify a right angle in different orientations.

steps.title: Find the right angle
steps.prompt: Which card shows a right angle?
hints: Look at the opening between the arms.
Compare each opening with the square corner.
One card fits a square corner even though it is turned.
Card B is a right angle. Choose B.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: What matters when you compare angles?

choices.label: The opening between the arms matters, even when the angle is turned.
Turning the whole card around makes the angle on it larger or smaller.

hints: Think about what stayed the same.
Use the relationship you just checked.
Read this explanation carefully: The opening between the arms matters, even when the angle is turned.
Choose: The opening between the arms matters, even when the angle is turned.
